# gate4agent

gate4agent is a library that drives CLI coding agents over PTY, pipe,
ACP, and daemon transports behind one API.

> **0.5.0 split.** `gate4agent-node`, `gate4agent-c2`,
> `gate4agent-c2-client` and `gate4agent-c2-protocol` are frozen at
> 0.4.8 on crates.io (not yanked) and are no longer in this repository.
> Their successors are `hatchery-node`, `hatchery-c2`,
> `hatchery-c2-client` and `hatchery-c2-protocol` in the hatchery
> repository.
